title: Who is really acting
goal: A user delegates to an agent, which delegates again.
obstacle: A flat token hides which agent in the chain did what.
control: Each hop keeps the user as subject and nests an actor claim.

steps.title: First hop
steps.tell: The agent exchanges for a token naming it as actor.
steps.say: The token says: user is the subject, the agent is acting.
steps.why: The data API can tell the user from the agent.

steps.title: Second hop
steps.tell: The sub-agent exchanges again; the act claim nests.
steps.say: Every hop adds itself; none can remove another.
steps.why: The whole chain stays visible to the resource.
